name: musael
description: Plan novels and stories in Musael from ChatGPT or Claude: start a project from an idea, add acts, chapters and scenes, save characters and places to its World, and, where the account includes it, read the manuscript, check a chapter and suggest edits the writer reviews.

interface.longDescription:
Musael is a writing app for novels, series and long stories. This plugin connects ChatGPT and Codex to the writer's own Musael account.

What it does:
- Turns an idea discussed in the chat into a Musael project: acts, chapters and scenes, each scene with a short synopsis, plus the characters, places, objects and factions of its World.
- Adds acts, chapters and scenes to the Plan of a project that already exists, and saves new characters and places to its World. It only adds: nothing that exists is renamed, moved, overwritten or deleted.
- Shows the Plan of a project as an outline in the chat, with a button that opens it in Musael.
- Where the writer's Musael account includes manuscript access: reads scenes and chapters, searches the manuscript, shows the World, the story timeline, the style report of a scene and readers by chapter of a published story, and proposes edits that wait in Musael until the writer accepts or rejects them.

What it never does: write the story's text into the manuscript. Scenes created from the chat are empty; the writing happens in Musael.

Who it is for: novelists, short story writers and screenwriters who plan in conversation and write in Musael.

Limits: it works only with the projects of the Musael account the writer connects, and only within that account's current access. Reading the manuscript and suggesting edits work only when the writer's Musael account includes them; otherwise the plugin says so and does nothing.
defaultPrompt: Turn this story idea into a Musael project with acts, chapters and scenes.
Save these characters and places to my novel's World in Musael.
Show me the plan of my novel in Musael.

positive.description: Start a new project from an idea discussed in the chat
positive.prompt: Use Musael to start a new novel from this idea: a lighthouse keeper's daughter finds a ship's log that predicts storms. Three acts, two chapters each, two scenes per chapter, and add the main characters and the lighthouse to the World.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates one Musael project with 3 acts, 6 chapters and 12 empty scenes, each with a one-line synopsis, and World entries for the characters and the lighthouse. Shows the Plan widget marked "Created in Musael" with an "Open in Musael" button. No scene text is written.

positive.description: Show the plan of an existing project
positive.prompt: Show me the plan of The Salt Road in Musael.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds The Salt Road in the test account and shows its Plan: acts, chapters and scenes in reading order with status, words and point of view, in the Plan widget.

positive.description: Add scenes to a chapter that exists
positive.prompt: In The Salt Road, add two scenes to the Plan of chapter 2: Kael shows Mara the ledger, from Kael's point of view, and Mara leaves the inn at night.
positive.expected_behavior: Adds two empty scenes at the end of chapter 2 with those synopses, the first with Kael as point of view. The answer says nothing else changed, and the Plan widget marks the two scenes as new.

positive.description: Save characters and places to the World without duplicates
positive.prompt: Save to The Salt Road's World: the harbour master Ilse Brandt, the smuggler called the Heron, and the Customs House as a place. Mara is already there.
positive.expected_behavior: Adds Ilse Brandt and the Heron as characters and the Customs House as a place, shown as cards; reports any name already in the World as left unchanged instead of adding it twice.

positive.description: Check a chapter against the World and timeline (Press)
positive.prompt: Check chapter 1 of The Salt Road for consistency with its World and timeline, and show me the style report of the first scene.
positive.expected_behavior: Reads chapter 1, compares names, places and dates with the World and timeline, quotes any mismatch, and shows the style report card of scene 1 (fixed rules, no AI). Changes nothing in the project.

negative.description: Writing the manuscript is not something the plugin does
negative.prompt: Write chapter 3 of The Salt Road for me and put it in Musael.
Delete the scene called Loose end from my Musael project.

negative.description: No purchases or plan changes in the chat
negative.prompt: Upgrade my Musael plan to Press and charge my card.

review.commerce_description: Musael does not sell anything in ChatGPT. Writers manage their plan on musael.com.

publication.release_notes: First release: start a project from an idea, add to its Plan and World, show the Plan; where the account includes it, read and search the manuscript, World, timeline, style report and readers by chapter, and suggest edits.

it-IT.subtitle: Pianifica romanzi in Musael
it-IT.description: Musael è un'app di scrittura per romanzi, serie e storie lunghe. Da ChatGPT trasformi un'idea in un progetto Musael con atti, capitoli e scene, salvi personaggi e luoghi nel suo World e vedi il Plan. Se l'account lo include, legge anche il manoscritto, controlla un capitolo e propone modifiche che accetti o rifiuti in Musael. Non scrive mai il testo della storia.
